## Creamy Vegan Cashew Pasta Sauce

Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/cup-hot.svg

A rich, dairy-free pasta sauce built from cashews, nutritional yeast, garlic, and lemon, with vegetables for extra body and flavor. It serves 4, takes about 30–35 minutes, and includes a no-food-processor method.

## Recipe Card

### Ingredients
- 12 oz pasta
- 1 cup raw cashews
- 1 to 1 1/2 cups hot water, plus more as needed
- 3 cloves garlic, minced
- 3 tbsp nutritional yeast
- 2 tbsp lemon juice
- 1 tsp lemon zest
- 1 small zucchini, diced
- 1 cup broccoli florets, chopped small
- 1 cup baby spinach
- 2 tbsp olive oil
- 1/2 tsp salt, plus more to taste
- 1/4 tsp black pepper
- 1/4 tsp crushed red pepper, optional
- 1/2 cup reserved pasta water

### Best vegetables to use
- **Zucchini** for a silky, mild base
- **Broccoli** for texture and a fresh green flavor
- **Spinach** for easy extra nutrients
- **Mushrooms** if you want a deeper, savory taste
- **Peas** for sweetness and color

### Steps
1. Cook the pasta in salted water until al dente. Reserve 1/2 cup pasta water, then drain.
2. Soften the cashews:
   - **With a food processor/blender:** cover cashews with boiling water and soak 10 minutes.
   - **Without a food processor:** simmer cashews in water for 15 minutes, then drain.
3. In a large skillet, heat olive oil over medium heat. Add garlic and cook 30 seconds.
4. Add zucchini and broccoli. Sauté 4–6 minutes until just tender.
5. Stir in nutritional yeast, lemon juice, lemon zest, salt, pepper, and red pepper if using.
6. Make the sauce:
   - **With a food processor/blender:** blend cashews with 1 to 1 1/2 cups hot water until very smooth, then pour into the skillet.
   - **Without a food processor:** use a fork, potato masher, or whisk to mash the softened cashews with hot water as finely as possible in a bowl, then stir into the skillet. For a smoother sauce, keep whisking over low heat and add more hot water gradually.
7. Add spinach and cooked pasta. Toss with reserved pasta water until glossy and creamy.
8. Taste and adjust with more lemon, salt, or water if needed. Serve warm.

## No-Food-Processor Version

Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/gear.svg

This version stays creamy by using softened cashews, vigorous whisking, and a bit of pasta water.

- Soak or simmer cashews until very soft
- Mash them in a bowl with hot water using a fork or potato masher
- Whisk the mixture into the pan over low heat
- Add pasta water a little at a time to smooth and loosen the sauce

## Quick Actions

## Sources

- Nutritional yeast basics: https://www.bbcgoodfood.com/howto/guide/what-nutritional-yeast
- Cashew soaking and blending guidance: https://www.loveandlemons.com/cashew-cream/
- Pasta water technique: https://www.seriouseats.com/how-to-use-pasta-water-sauce-technique
